products.name: Wyze Cam v4
products.query: Wyze Cam v4 2.5K indoor outdoor security camera
products.summary: A low-cost plug-in camera with 2.5K video and color night vision. It records to your own microSD card, so the core features need no plan.
products.renterNote: Plugs into an outlet and sits on a shelf, so there is no drilling and it comes with you when you move. The caveat is that smart detection for people, pets and packages and cloud clips sit behind the paid Cam Plus plan.
pros: Records locally to a microSD card (card not included), so basic use needs no subscription
2.5K (2560x1440) video with a wide field of view of about 116 degrees diagonal, per Wyze's spec sheet
Rated IP65, so a steamy bathroom or a covered balcony is less of a worry than with indoor-only cameras
cons: Owners on Wyze's forum report firmware updates that left some cameras slow or unresponsive
Several owners find the microphone and two-way audio weak, and a few report hardware failures after about 1.5 years
facts: Resolution 2560x1440 (2.5K QHD); field of view 115.8 degrees diagonal, 98.5 horizontal, 53.1 vertical (Wyze tech specs)
IP65 rated for indoor and outdoor use, not fully waterproof (Wyze)
Local recording to a microSD card that is not included; the supported card size differs between Wyze and retailer pages, so check the current spec sheet before buying
Built-in siren and 2-LED spotlight (Wyze tech specs)
Smart detection and cloud storage are part of the paid Cam Plus plan; basic motion alerts and live view work without it
products.scoreNote: Plug-in, shelf-ready and subscription-free for core recording, which is the lowest-cost entry of the three; works with Alexa and Google Assistant, and AI detection is a paid add-on.

praise: Image quality and resolution for the money
Local microSD recording avoids cloud fees
complaints: Firmware updates that slowed or froze some cameras
Weak microphone and two-way audio pickup
Some units failed after roughly a year and a half

products.name: Ring Indoor Cam (2nd Gen)
products.query: Ring Indoor Cam 2nd Gen plug-in 1080p security camera with privacy cover
products.summary: A small 1080p plug-in camera with a manual privacy cover over the lens. Live view is free, but saved recordings need a Ring plan.
products.renterNote: Plugs in and sits on a shelf with no drilling, and it works with Alexa and the Ring app. The caveat is that it has no onboard or microSD storage, so reviewing missed events means paying for a Ring Home subscription after the free trial.
pros: Manual privacy cover over the lens, which reviewers like for bedrooms and living rooms
1080p video with color night vision, two-way talk and a siren
Very compact and set up in minutes through the Ring app, per reviewers
cons: No local storage: recorded history, sharing and most smart features depend on a paid Ring Home subscription
1080p is the lowest resolution of the three and the optics are largely unchanged from the first generation, per reviewers
facts: 1080p HD video with color night vision (retailer listings)
143 degrees diagonal, 115 horizontal, 59 vertical field of view (Ring support page)
Manual privacy cover that blocks the lens, per Ring and retailer listings
Powered by a plug-in adapter; 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi (802.11 b/g/n); Ring recommends 2 Mbps upload speed
Real-time notifications, Live View and Two-Way Talk are listed as free; recording, review and sharing need a Ring Home subscription (30-day trial per retailer listing)
No microSD or other onboard storage, per reviews
products.scoreNote: Easiest install and a real privacy cover, but no local storage means a paid Ring plan for recordings, and compatibility centers on Alexa and Ring.

praise: Tiny, plugs in and sets up in minutes
Polished Ring app and Alexa integration
complaints: Best features and saved video need a paid subscription
Hardware and 1080p optics barely changed from the first generation

sources.title: Ring Indoor Cam 2nd Gen review (Digital Camera World)

products.name: eufy Indoor Cam C120
products.query: eufy Security Indoor Cam C120 2K plug-in security camera
products.summary: A compact 2K plug-in camera that records to a microSD card with no hub or mandatory plan, and supports Siri.
products.renterNote: Plug-in and freestanding, with no hub, drilling or wiring, so it moves with you. The caveat is black-and-white infrared night vision and 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only; it is not rated for outdoor use.
pros: Local microSD recording (card not included) with no required subscription and no HomeBase needed
2K video with human and pet detection, two-way audio and a siren
Works with Alexa and Google Assistant, and security.org notes Siri support, which few indoor cams offer
cons: Infrared-only night vision means black-and-white footage with less detail
A review measured about a one to two second lag in video and audio, and some listings give conflicting resolution figures, so check the spec before buying
facts: 2K resolution (some retailers list it as 3 MP)
Records to microSD (up to 128GB per eufy listings); card not included; cloud storage is an optional paid plan
Not rated for outdoor use (Wyze comparison page, treat as a competitor source)
Works with Alexa and Google Assistant; Siri support noted by security.org; no SmartThings or IFTTT per a review
products.scoreNote: Plug-in with local storage and no required plan; supports three assistants, but night vision is basic and some specs are inconsistent between listings.

praise: Local microSD storage with no mandatory subscription
complaints: A one to two second delay in live video and audio
Refurbished or renewed units sometimes arrive damaged or non-working
